entries.zh: 尚且：尚且、更何况（表让步下更进一层，『连……尚且』；西语 quanto y mas 即『何止如此、更有所加』）
entries.en: even, still more; how much more (Sp. quanto y mas)
entries.notes: M 栏一声调号污损（T99），词义据汉字『尚且』与西语 quanto y mas 互证

entries.zh: 尚且：尚且、更何况（上一条 xiang 拼法之变体，此处音写作 siang）
entries.en: even, still more; how much more (Sp. quanto y mas)
entries.notes: M 栏一声调号污损（T99）；与第 1 条同词异拼（siang/xiang）

entries.zh: 何但：何况、何止（更不必说，递进反诘语）
entries.en: how much more; not to mention, let alone (Sp. quanto mas comparando)
entries.notes: M 栏一声调号污损（T99），义据汉字『何但』与西语 quanto mas comparando 互证

entries.zh: 何况：何况、更不必说（以比较语气更进一层）
entries.en: how much more; still less, not to mention (Sp. quanto mas comparando 'by comparison')

entries.zh: 何兼：何况兼之、更兼（义同『何况』；第二字原标[疑:無/兼]，依音写当为『兼』）
entries.en: how much more; moreover (2nd char uncertain: 無 or 兼; the syllable read supports 兼)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字[疑:無/兼]；若作『無』则音写不合，判为『兼』，义同『何况』

entries.zh: 況且：况且、再说（承上文更进一层）
entries.en: moreover, besides; how much more (Sp. quanto mas comparando)
entries.notes: M 栏一声调号污损（T99），义据汉字『況且』与西语互证

entries.zh: 又兼：又兼、加之（更进一层的『何况』类用语；第二字原标[疑:無/兼]，依音写当为『兼』）
entries.en: moreover, besides; and how much more (2nd char uncertain: 無 or 兼)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字[疑:無/兼]，依音写判为『兼』

entries.zh: 況兼：況且兼之、更何况（明清白话习用递进语；第二字原标[疑:無/兼]，依音写当为『兼』）
entries.en: how much more; moreover and besides (2nd char uncertain: 無 or 兼)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字[疑:無/兼]，依音写判为『兼』；『況兼』为明清白话习语

entries.zh: 況今：况如今、当今更如何（以当今时势更进一层反问）
entries.en: how much more now; all the more at present (Sp. headword contains abbreviation 'q.', expanded by inference to que)
entries.notes: 西语词头含缩写 'q.'（依推断展开为 que），按规则降为中置信

entries.zh: 了幾：过了多久、（幾有）还剩多少（前半问已历时距；西语词头残损，当为 quanto habrá『将有多少』）
entries.en: how long has it been; how much will there be (Sp. quanto habrá; headword partly damaged)
entries.notes: 西语词头『q[残]abo』残损且 M 栏末音调号污损（T99），释义据汉字『了幾』与音写推定

entries.zh: 減幾下：尚欠多少、短少几多（问亏欠或不足之数；『下』字功能存疑）
entries.en: how much is lacking; how much is short or owed (Sp. quanto falta?)
entries.notes: 首音调号污损（T99）；『下』字作用不明，按亏欠义释

entries.zh: 欠幾：欠多少（马尼拉贸易赊欠语境，问账款数额）
entries.en: how much (is) owed; how much do you owe (Sp. quanto falta?)

entries.zh: 值幾：值多少钱（问价钱）
entries.en: how much is it worth; what is the price (Sp. quanto vale?)

entries.zh: 值幾數：值多少钱款（『數』谓钱数、账款，问金额大小）
entries.en: how much money is it worth; what is the amount (Sp. quanto vale?)

entries.zh: 值乜價：值什么价、卖什么价钱（『乜』即『什么』，问价）
entries.en: what price is it; how much is it worth (Sp. quanto vale?)
entries.notes: 末音调号污损（T99），义据汉字『值乜價』与西语互证

entries.zh: 貼到幾：贴到多少、正额之外加收几多（encima 谓正价之上所加之加码或利头，问加到几多）
entries.en: how much goes on top; how much is added above the fixed amount (overage or markup, Sp. de encima)

entries.zh: 多寡：多少、多寡（问数量之多或少；西语词头疑为 quanto mucho o poco『多或少』）
entries.en: how much; more or less; quantity (Spanish tail word uncertain, likely 'o poco')
entries.notes: 西语词头尾词[疑:opoço/oposo]，疑当读 'o poco'（多或少），降为中置信

entries.zh: 多少：多少（问数量；音写兼录长短两式读法）
entries.en: how many, how much; what quantity
entries.notes: 同上条，西语词头尾词[疑:opoço/oposo]存疑，降为中置信

entries.zh: 有幾重：有几分重、重多少（问货物斤两）
entries.en: how much does it weigh; what is the weight (Sp. quanto pesa?)
entries.notes: 末音写[疑:pang/tang]两读，据汉字『重』取『重』之正读，降为中置信

entries.zh: 幾久：多久、几长时间（问时距长短）
entries.en: how long; how much time (Sp. quanto tiempo habrá)

entries.zh: 幾萬：几万、几万之数（极言其多；西语接 'tiempo largo'，或谓岁月悠远久经几万，对应存疑）
entries.en: how many ten-thousands; ever so many, ever so long (hyperbolic; pairing with Sp. 'tiempo largo' uncertain)
entries.notes: 首音调号污损（T99）；且汉字『幾萬』与西语 'tiempo largo' 之对应须由夸饰义推合，释义存疑
